content:
Alex: Quick sync — opened a docs PR to consolidate cross-zone KMS/HSM examples and fix a couple broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2412
Maria: Thanks — linkcheck already flagged the old transit-gw doc. Can you add the transit-gateway example for egress routing?
Alex: Yep planning to add a short diagram + config snippet. Also need a minimal nftables example for customers who use host firewall.
Jia: I have a tested nftables snippet we used on staging. Will paste. Also add a systemd unit override tip for the kms proxy (Restart=always + RestartSec=5).
Sam: For air-gapped: we should include the offline bundle checksum command and the minimal CA trust steps. I can paste the tarball signing/verify commands.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck failed in docs/kms/cross-zone.md -> ./transit-gateway.md (404) — see job #524
Alex: Ok I'll update the link to the new transit gateway guide and add an anchor. Will push a fix shortly.
Maria: nftables snippet (tested on ubuntu20):
```
# allow KMS traffic to HSM cluster (TCP 23456)
table inet redwood_kms {
  chain prerouting { type nat hook prerouting priority 0; }
  chain output { type nat hook output priority 0; }
  chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
}
# example rule: accept established to HSM
add rule inet redwood_kms forward ct state established,related accept
add rule inet redwood_kms forward ip daddr 10.4.12.0/24 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Jia: Also add this systemd hint for the proxy service: `sudo systemctl edit redwood-kms-proxy` then override with:
```
[Service]
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
```
Sam: Offline bundle verify commands: `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256` — add note about offline key import (gpg --import)
Tess: Quick UX note: in the install guide we currently use both "HSM" and "hsm" in headings — standardize to uppercase HSM. Small but helps search.
Alex: Good catch, I'll run a heading sweep. I'm going to: update transit-gateway link, add nftables + systemd + checksum snippets, and push an amended PR.
DocsBot: CI: new commit pushed to PR #2412 — running tests.
Maria: Want me to review before you merge? I can check the wording around private-VPC routing.
Alex: Yes please, @Maria. I'll ping when the commit is ready.
Sam: After merge, can we backport the snippets to the onprem quickstart (v1.2) doc? Some customers use the older installer.
Alex: Yup will include a short backport patch and add a note: "applies to installer v1.x".
Tess: pinging security to ensure pkcs11 examples don't leak policies — @Jia please coordinate if any sensitive details are present.
Jia: Will scrub any real role mappings and replace with placeholders (e.g., `role: redwood-hsm-readonly`).
Alex: Thanks all — aiming to have edits up in ~45m.
Maria: :thumbsup:
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed. Ready to merge.
Alex: Merged and backported to v1.2 branch. Closing thread.
